name: gdb-rtos-views
description: RTOS kernel state views for embedded debugging, driven by the GDR

gdr.runtimePath.markdownDescription: Directory holding `gdr.py` and the `gdr`/`rtthread`/`freertos` packages. Empty uses the copy bundled in this extension; set this to run the plugin against a development checkout.

gdr.rtos.description: Adapter to initialize. Leave empty to use the probe result, or when the workspace has a single RTOS with an unambiguous version.

gdr.version.description: Exact RTOS version to initialize. Required together with gdr.rtos when the probe cannot read one.

gdr.autoInit.description: Initialize the adapter automatically at the first stop when the probe is unambiguous, instead of asking.

gdr.refreshOnStop.description: Refresh the RTOS panel at each stop; turn it off to only refresh on initialization or with the panel's refresh button.

gdr.refreshHeaps.description: Include the heap snapshot in every refresh. The heap walk is the most expensive part; disable it when stops feel slow.

gdr.refreshDetails.description: Include the per-kind detail tables (semaphores, mutexes, mailboxes, message queues, pools, timers) in every refresh. Each one walks its objects' entries; disable it when stops feel slow.

gdr.recordSnapshotsDir.description: Directory to write one JSON envelope per applied refresh (for bug reports and offline inspection). Empty disables recording.

enumDescriptions: Read the envelope from DAP evaluate results (inline, or base64 frames when large). Works everywhere, including remote debug servers.
Ask GDB to write the envelope to a file and read it back; cheaper for very large snapshots, but the extension must be able to read the filesystem GDB writes to.
gdr.snapshotTransport.markdownDescription: How the panel's snapshot crosses from GDB to the extension. `file` runs `gdr api snapshot --json --out <tmp>` and reads the file instead of the evaluate transport; it needs the filesystem GDB writes to be readable by the extension — true for a locally started GDB (whether gdbserver is local or remote) and for Remote-SSH/Dev Containers, where the extension runs beside GDB, but not for a GDB in a separate filesystem namespace (for example WSL).

scripts.package: npm run vendor && npm run build && vsce package --out gdb-rtos-views.vsix
